title: Oath of friendship
introduction: Hanuma fetches Rama and Lakshmana to Sugreeva, and advises him to befriend Rama. Accordingly Rama and Sugreeva take the oath of friendship before an altar of fire and Rama assures to eliminate Vali the vice, from the face of earth.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 5h chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ऋश्यमूकात् तु हनुमान् गत्वा तम् मलयम् गिरिम् |
आचचक्षे तदा वीरौ कपि राजाय राघवौ
verses.iast:
ṛśyamūkāt tu hanumān gatvā tam malayam girim |
ācacakṣe tadā vīrau kapi rājāya rāghavau
verses.translation: Hanuma on going from Mt. Rishyamuka to Mt. Malaya, has reported to the king of monkeys Sugreeva, about the two valiant Raghava-s.

glosses.meaning: to that, Mt. Malaya, having gone

verses.devanagari:
अयम् रामो महाप्राज्ञ संप्राप्तो दृढ विक्रमः |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा रामोऽयम् सत्य विक्रमः
verses.iast:
ayam rāmo mahāprājña samprāpto dṛḍha vikramaḥ |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā rāmo'yam satya vikramaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh! great discerner Sugreeva, this is Rama... oh, stubbornly valiant Sugreeva, this virtuously valiant Rama arrived along with his brother Lakshmana...

verses.devanagari:
इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले जातो रामो दशरथात्मजः |
धर्मे निगदितः च एव पितुर् निर्देश कारकः
verses.iast:
ikṣvākūṇām kule jāto rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ |
dharme nigaditaḥ ca eva pitur nirdeśa kārakaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama is the son of king Dasharatha, one born in Ikshvaku dynasty, an adept one in virtue and thus an adherent of his father's orders...

glosses.meaning: in Ikshvaku, dynasty, born, Dasharatha's, son

verses.devanagari:
राजसूय अश्वमेधैः च वह्निः येन अभितर्पितः |
दक्षिणाः च तथा उत्सृष्टा गावः शत सहस्रशः
तपसा सत्य वाक्येन वसुधा येन पालिता |
स्त्री हेतोः तस्य पुत्रोऽयम् रामः अरणयम् समागतः
verses.iast:
rājasūya aśvamedhaiḥ ca vahniḥ yena abhitarpitaḥ |
dakṣiṇāḥ ca tathā ut.hsṛṣṭā gāvaḥ śata sahasraśaḥ
tapasā satya vākyena vasudhā yena pālitā |
strī hetoḥ tasya putro'yam rāmaḥ araṇayam samāgataḥ
verses.translation: "By whom the ritual fire is well worshipped in Vedic rituals like rajasuuya, ashvametha, and thus cows in hundreds and thousands are donated in those rituals, by whom this earth is ruled devoutly and truthful to his word, such Dasharatha's son is this Rama, who has to come to forests owing to a woman...

glosses.meaning: in hundreds and thousands, cows, as charities, were given
a lady, being the reason, to forests, he came.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य अस्य वसतो अरण्ये नियतस्य महात्मनः |
रावणेन हृता भार्या स त्वाम् शरणम् आगतः
verses.iast:
tasya asya vasato araṇye niyatasya mahātmanaḥ |
rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā sa tvām śaraṇam āgataḥ
verses.translation: "Ravana stole the wife of this principled one and great soul Rama when dwelling in forests, such as he is, he came seeking your refuge...

glosses.meaning: such as he is, to you, for shelter, he came.

verses.devanagari:
भवता सख्य कामौ तौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ |
प्रगृह्य च अर्चयस्व एतौ पूजनीयतमौ उभौ
verses.iast:
bhavatā sakhya kāmau tau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau |
pragṛhya ca arcayasva etau pūjanīyatamau ubhau
verses.translation: "These two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, are interested to make friendship with you... thus you receive these two and worship them, for they are most venerable ones..." Hanuma thus advised Sugreeva.
notes: Here Hanuma's role as teacher is depicted. God comes to the rescue of the needy, and communicates through a competent teacher. Only the teacher can visualize the god and his intent, and thus narrate it to the taught. That is what Hanuma's advise to Sugreeva.

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यम् सुग्रीवो वानर अधिपः |
दर्शनीयतमो भूत्वा प्रीत्या उवाच राघवम्
verses.iast:
śrutvā hanumato vākyam sugrīvo vānara adhipaḥ |
darśanīyatamo bhūtvā prītyā uvāca rāghavam
verses.translation: On hearing Hanuma's words Sugreeva, the chief of monkeys has become presentable and gladly spoke to Rama.
notes: Sugreeva is not in a presentable form till now because he is outrageously furious with 'friend-or-foe' syndrome, on seeing Rama and Lakshmana. None can calm these vanara heroes down, except their own favourable interests. On listening from Hanuma that the entrants are friends, Sugreeva got his cool back, and thus became 'presentable,' befitting to his honourable kingship.

verses.devanagari:
भवान् धर्म विनीतः च सुतपाः सर्व वत्सलः |
आख्याता वायुपुत्रेण तत्त्वतो मे भवद् गुणाः
verses.iast:
bhavān dharma vinītaḥ ca sutapāḥ sarva vatsalaḥ |
ākhyātā vāyuputreṇa tattvato me bhavad guṇāḥ
verses.translation: "You are a trained one in treading righteous path, best by your scruples, and a kindlier one to all, so said Air-god's son Hanuma to me about your attributes, in subtlety...

glosses.meaning: virtue knower [you are trained to tread virtuous path]
said so by, Air's son, Hanuma

verses.devanagari:
तन् मम एव एष सत्कारो लाभः च एव उत्तमः प्रभो |
यत् त्वम् इच्छसि सौहार्दम् वानरेण मया सह
verses.iast:
tan mama eva eṣa satkāro lābhaḥ ca eva uttamaḥ prabho |
yat tvam icchasi sauhārdam vānareṇa mayā saha
verses.translation: "Therefor oh, lord, you wish to make friendship with a monkey like me, thereby this is an honour and a best achievement to me alone...

glosses.itrans: tat tvam vaanareNa mayaa saha sauhaardam icChasi
glosses.iast: tat tvam vānareṇa mayā saha sauhārdam icchasi
glosses.devanagari: तत् त्वं वानरेण मया सह सौहार्दं इच्छसि
glosses.meaning: therefor, you, with a monkey, [like] me, along with, friendship, you wish to have
thus, that which topic is there

verses.devanagari:
रोचते यदि मे सख्यम् बाहुः एष प्रसारितः |
गृह्यताम् पाणिना पाणिः मर्यादा बध्यताम् ध्रुवा
verses.iast:
rocate yadi me sakhyam bāhuḥ eṣa prasāritaḥ |
gṛhyatām pāṇinā pāṇiḥ maryādā badhyatām dhruvā
verses.translation: "If you aspire my friendship here I extend my arm, take this hand of mine into yours, thus let the convention be stably made fast..." Thus Sugreeva proffered friendship to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य सुभाषितम् |
संप्रहृष्ट मना हस्तम् पीडयामास पाणिना
हृष्टः सौहृदम् आलम्ब्य पर्यष्वजत पीडितम् |
verses.iast:
etat tu vacanam śrutvā sugrīvasya subhāṣitam |
samprahṛṣṭa manā hastam pīḍayāmāsa pāṇinā
hṛṣṭaḥ sauhṛdam ālam.hbya paryaṣvajata pīḍitam |
verses.translation: Rama is gladdened at heart on listening all those words well said by Sugreeva, and then clutched Sugreeva's hand in his, and ardently abiding by the vow of friendship he embraced Sugreeva, grippingly and happily.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हनूमान् संत्यज्य भिक्षु रूपम् अरिन्दमः
काष्ठयोः स्वेन रूपेण जनयामास पावकम् |
दीप्यमानम् ततो वह्निम् पुष्पैः अभ्यर्च्य सत्कृतम्
तयोर् मध्ये तु सुप्रीतो निदधौ सुसमाहितः |
verses.iast:
tato hanūmān santyajya bhikṣu rūpam arindamaḥ
kāṣṭhayoḥ svena rūpeṇa janayāmāsa pāvakam |
dīpyamānam tato vahnim puṣpaiḥ abhyarcya satkṛtam
tayor madhye tu suprīto nidadhau susamāhitaḥ |
verses.translation: Then the destroyer of enemies Hanuma discarding the guise of ascetic assumed his original monkey form, and on producing fire with two sticks then made it to glow. decorated, worshipped with flowers, then gladly and devoutly placed that fire in between Rama and Sugreeva.
notes: The holy fire used to kindle the ritual fire in a yajña will be produced by constantly rubbing two dry wood sticks, and this is called as araṇi . When sparkles of fire and a little fume appear, it will be put into the Altar of Fire. Here, Hanuma has changed his ascetic form to his original monkey shape. This form changing at their will and wish is called kāmarūpa vidya, changing guise at will, which will be useful to Hanuma in the coming episodes of Ramayana.

glosses.meaning: with two sticks, fire, started to ignite

verses.devanagari:
ततो अग्निम् दीप्यमानम् तौ चक्रतुः च प्रदक्षिणम्
सुग्रीवो राघवः च एव वयस्यत्वम् उपागतौ |
verses.iast:
tato agnim dīpyamānam tau cakratuḥ ca pradakṣiṇam
sugrīvo rāghavaḥ ca eva vayasyatvam upāgatau |
verses.translation: Then those two performed circumambulations to that well glowing ritual fire, and thus, Rama and Sugreeva entered into the pact of friendship.

glosses.meaning: they two, glowing, at fire, circumambulations, they made

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुप्रीत मनसौ तौ उभौ हरि राघवौ
अन्योन्यम् अभिवीक्षन्तौ न तृप्तिम् अभिजग्मतुः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ suprīta manasau tau ubhau hari rāghavau
anyonyam abhivīkṣantau na tṛptim abhijagmatuḥ |
verses.translation: And then gladdened at heart are those two, that monkey and Raghava, gazed enough at each other eye-to-eye, but their hearts did not derive any fraternal satisfaction.

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् वयस्योऽसि हृद्यः मे हि एकम् दुःखम् सुखम् च नौ
सुग्रीवो राघवम् वाक्यम् इति उवाच प्रहृष्टवत् |
verses.iast:
tvam vayasyo'si hṛdyaḥ me hi ekam duḥkham sukham ca nau
sugrīvo rāghavam vākyam iti uvāca prahṛṣṭavat |
verses.translation: Sugreeva rejoicingly said to Raghava, "you are the amiable friend of mine, henceforth our mirth or miseries are same for us..."

glosses.meaning: you, are my, amiable, friend, you are
our, mirth, misery, are one [the same]

glosses.itrans: iti sugriivaH prahR^iSTa vat raaghvam vaakyam uvaacha
glosses.iast: iti sugrīvaḥ prahṛṣṭa vat rāghvam vākyam uvāca
glosses.devanagari: इति सुग्रीवः प्रहृष्ट वत् राघ्वं वाक्यं उवाच
glosses.meaning: thus, Sugreeva, rejoicingly, to Raghava, sentence, said.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुपर्ण बहुलाम् भंक्त्वा शाखाम् सुपुष्पिताम्
सालस्य आस्तीर्य सुग्रीवः निषसाद स राघवः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ suparṇa bahulām bhaṃk.htvā śākhām supuṣpitām
sālasya āstīrya sugrīvaḥ niṣasāda sa rāghavaḥ |
verses.translation: And then Sugreeva snapped off and spread a fully flowered tree-branch of sala tree with many leaves, and sat on it along with Rama.

glosses.meaning: of sala tree, with leaves, many

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मनाय अथ संहृष्टो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः
शखाम् चन्दन वृक्षस्य ददौ परम पुष्पिताम् |
verses.iast:
lakśmanāya atha saṃhṛṣṭo hanumān mārutātmajaḥ
śakhām candana vṛkśasya dadau parama puṣpitām |
verses.translation: Then Hanuma the son of Air, gladly gave a well-flowered branch of sandalwood tree to Lakshmana...

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः श्लक्ष्णम् मधुरया गिरा
प्रति उवाच तदा रामम् हर्ष व्याकुल लोचनः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ ślakśṇam madhurayā girā
prati uvāca tadā rāmam harṣa vyākula locanaḥ |
verses.translation: Then that delighted Sugreeva with his sweet words, and with his eyes quavering in happiness, replied Rama softly.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् विनिकृतो राम चरमि इह भय आर्दितः
हृत भार्यो वने त्रस्तो दुर्गम् एतत् उपाश्रितः |
verses.iast:
aham vinikṛto rāma carami iha bhaya ārditaḥ
hṛta bhāryo vane trasto durgam etat upāśritaḥ |
verses.translation: "Rama, I am ridiculed, stolen is my wife, I move here about in these forests with dread and fear haunting me... I took refuge in this impenetrable forest...

glosses.meaning: here about, in forest, I am moving

verses.devanagari:
सोऽहम् त्रस्तो वने भीतो वसामि उद् भ्रान्त चेतनः
वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृत वैरः च राघव |
verses.iast:
so'ham trasto vane bhīto vasāmi ud.h bhrānta cetanaḥ
vālinā nikṛto bhrātrā kṛta vairaḥ ca rāghava |
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava, my brother denounced me, he even made me an enemy of his, such as I am I am living in these forests with scare and fear, and with dismayed vitality...

verses.devanagari:
वालिनो मे महाभाग भय आर्तस्य अभयम् कुरु
कर्तुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थः भयम् मे न भवेद् यथा |
verses.iast:
vālino me mahābhāga bhaya ārtasya abhayam kuru
kartum arhasi kākut.hsthaḥ bhayam me na bhaved yathā |
verses.translation: "Oh, highly fortunate Rama, affirm fearlessness to me from Vali by who I am highly intimidated, and as to how there will be fearlessness to me from him, it will be apt of you to accomplish that, that way...

glosses.meaning: to me, as to how, fear, will not, be there
to do so, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः
प्रति अभाषत काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीवम् प्रहसन् इव |
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu tejasvī dharmajño dharma vatsalaḥ
prati abhāṣata kākut.hsthaḥ sugrīvam prahasan iva |
verses.translation: When thus said, that resplendent and righteous one being the patron of virtue Rama replied Sugreeva, as though laughing off.

verses.devanagari:
उपकार फलम् मित्रम् विदितम् मे महाकपे
वालिनम् तम् वधिष्यामि तव भार्य अपहारिणम् |
verses.iast:
upakāra phalam mitram viditam me mahākape
vālinam tam vadhiṣyāmi tava bhārya apahāriṇam |
verses.translation: "A friend is the resultant factor of helpfulness... that I know... oh, great monkey I intend eliminate that Vali, the abductor of your wife... [4-5-2b, 26a5]

verses.devanagari:
अमोघोः सूर्य संकाशाः मम इमे निशिताः शराः
तस्मिन् वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते निपतिष्यन्ति वेगिताः |
कन्क पत्र प्रतिच्छन्ना महेन्द्र अशनि संनिभाः
तीक्ष्णाग्रा ऋजुपर्वाणः स रोषा भुजगा इव |
verses.iast:
amoghoḥ sūrya saṃkāśāḥ mama ime niśitāḥ śarāḥ
tasmin vālini dur.hvṛtte nipatiṣyanti vegitāḥ |
kanka patra praticchannā mahendra aśani saṃnibhāḥ
tīkśṇāgrā ṛjuparvāṇaḥ sa roṣā bhujagā iva |
verses.translation: "Unfailing are these arrows of mine, scorchers like sun, sharp ones tied with eagle feathers, similar to Indra's Thunderbolts, sharp are their point and straight is their egress, similar to enraged snakes, and these arrows of mine will be speeded up to fall on that vicious Vali...

verses.devanagari:
तम् अद्य वालिनम् पश्य तीक्ष्णैः आशी विष उपमैः
शरैः विनिहितम् भूमौ प्रकीर्णम् इव पर्वतम् |
verses.iast:
tam adya vālinam paśya tīkśṇaiḥ āśī viṣa upamaiḥ
śaraiḥ vinihitam bhūmau prakīrṇam iva parvatam |
verses.translation: "You will see now itself the falling of Vali like a splintered mountain onto ground, when completely ruined by these cruel arrows that are similar to venomous snakes..." Thus Rama inculcated confidence in Sugreeva.

verses.devanagari:
स तु तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राघवस्य आत्मनोहितम् |
सुग्रीवः परम प्रीतः परमम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa tu tad vacanam śrutvā rāghavasya ātmanohitam |
sugrīvaḥ parama prītaḥ paramam vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing Raghava's words that are appeasing for his self, Sugreeva is very completely satisfied and said this fine sentence. [4-5-29b, c]

verses.devanagari:
तव प्रसादेन नृसिंह वीर
प्रियाम् च राज्यम् च समाप्नुयाम् अहम् |
तथा कुरु त्वम् नर देव वैरिणम्
यथा न हिंस्यत् स पुनर् मम अग्रजम्
verses.iast:
tava prasādena nṛsiṃha vīra
priyām ca rājyam ca samāpnuyām aham |
tathā kuru tvam nara deva vairiṇam
yathā na hiṃsyat sa punar mama agrajam
verses.translation: "By your grace, oh, lion among men, let me regain my wife and kingdom too... oh, god of humans, as to how he does not suffer me again, thus you may please make happen... let not my elder brother turned as an enemy of mine suffer me again...

verses.devanagari:
सीत कपीन्द्र क्षणदा चराणाम्
राजीव हेम ज्वलनोपमानानि |
सुग्रीव राम प्रणय पसङ्गे
वामानि नेत्राणि समम् स्फुरन्ति
verses.iast:
sīta kapīndra kśaṇadā carāṇām
rājīva hema jvalanopamānāni |
sugrīva rāma praṇaya pasañge
vāmāni netrāṇi samam sphuranti
verses.translation: During the friendly conversation of Rama and Sugreeva, the left eyes of Seetha, Vali and Ravana that bear similitude with lotuses, golden orbs, and fireballs respectively have fluttered equally.
notes: This verse is in krama alankāra, an equated metaphoric expression, by juxtaposing words equally to compare Seetha's eyes with lotuses, Vali's eyes with golden-balls for his complexion is golden, and Ravana's eyes with fireballs. But all are left eyes only that have fluttered. The flutter of left eye to the male is a bad omen while to the female it is a good omen. Hence the friendship of Rama and Sugreeva is the seedling point for eradication of vice, namely Vali and Ravana, from face of the earth.
